claims.claim: SGLang distinguishes offline loading of pre-quantized weights from online dynamic quantization; pre-quantized checkpoints should not also be passed through the online --quantization flag
claims.locator: Quantization overview: offline vs online and pre-quantized checkpoint warning

claims.claim: The quantization registry maps method names to QuantizationConfig classes and conditionally registers some methods by hardware platform
Checkpoint quantization metadata is resolved from top-level quantization_config, text_config.quantization_config, then compression_config
SGLang quantization methods expose per-layer weight creation, apply, and post-load processing hooks; quantization config declares supported activation dtypes and minimum hardware capability
AWQ uses activation statistics to identify salient channels and applies equivalent scaling transformations to reduce low-bit weight quantization error
GPTQ is a post-training weight quantization method based on approximate second-order information and sequential weight updates
SGLang recommends validating quantized models with benchmarks after quantization because quality regressions depend on the model and recipe
